description: Routes départementales d’Eure-et-Loir is a dataset listed in Open data - Département d'Eure-et-Loir, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CD28. Référentiel du réseau routier géré par le département d’Eure-et-Loir, y compris des portions de routes de départements limitrophes. Ces données sont réputées exactes sous réserve de déclassement ou reclassement en cours. Coverage: Eure-et-Loir. The portal files it under Routes. Its keywords are Données de référence. The portal shows 8,301 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-eurelien-fr-portal.
